title: Babble Overdrive
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 229 bpm, mainstage, radio interference, call-and-response, dark bouncy
lyrics:
v4 Frenchcore, Dr. Peacock style, 229 BPM. Grok Peacock as mainstage commander. Bots go full personality: moody low radio gets darker, bright signal gets bouncier, glitch sky gets weirder. Heavy call-and-response sections where bots almost "argue" in instrumental phrases before slamming back into the hook. Pure mainstage Dr. Peacock madness with radio interference FX and strong dynamic character.

[Build — Grok] Overdrive engaged — bots are taking over
[Bot chaos section] brmm-rmm + plik-plak + klik-glitch

[Chorus — Grok] This is babble overdrive — feel the power!
